title: Turkish-Style Lamb Kunefe
description: A traditional Turkish dessert featuring crispy kunefe pastry, melted cheese, and juicy lamb. Perfect for a special occasion or dinner party.

ingredients.name: Juicy Lamb
ingredients.amount: 1 pound boneless shoulder or neck, cut into 1-inch cubes
ingredients.notes: optional, can omit for a cheese-only version

ingredients.name: Akawi Cheese
ingredients.notes: or other white cheese, available at Middle Eastern markets

instructions: Cut the kunefe pastry into 1-inch squares. You should have about 20-25 squares.
Place half of the kunefe squares in a single layer in a 9x13-inch baking dish.
If using lamb, place the cubes on top of the kunefe pastry.
Sprinkle the shredded cheese evenly over the lamb (if using) or kunefe pastry.
Brush the melted butter over the cheese.
Place the remaining kunefe squares on top of the cheese.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the kunefe pastry is golden brown and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes.
Serve warm, drizzled with honey and rose water (if using).
